Goal: Create a Risk Factor Model using PCA

Chosen portfolio: S&P500



```{r}
#download packages
library(tidyquant) #https://business-science.github.io/tidyquant/
library(tidyverse) #https://tidyverse.org/
library(Matrix)    #https://codeberg.org/jaganmn/Matrix
```

```{r}
#download index of s&p500
basket <- tq_index("S&P500")
```

```{r}
head(basket)
write.csv(basket, "sp500_basket.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#clean the dataframe
df <- read_csv("sp500_basket.csv")

colSums(is.na(df))
colSums(df == "" | df == " " | df == "-", na.rm = TRUE)

df_clean <- df |>
  mutate(sector = na_if(sector, ""),
         sector = na_if(sector, "-"))
df_clean$sector <- NULL

head(df_clean)
```

    mutate(
        pe = (price/earnings),
        eps = (earnings / num_shares),
        peg = (pe/growth_rate),
        current = (cur_asset/cur_liab),
        quick = ((cash + mark_secur + acc_rec)/cur_liab),
        cash = ((cash + cash_equiv)/cur_liab), 
        operating_nwc = (cur_asset - cash)-(cur_liab - debt),
        debt = (tot_liab/tot_asset),
        de = (tot_liab/tot_share_equity),
        TIE = (EBIT/int_expense),
        )
